bias.en: Uptrend pausing · lost the $524 Oct 16 low
bias.zh: 上升趋势暂停 · 跌破 10月16日低点 $524

read.en: Microsoft fell 2.2% on Oct 22 to $521.08, trading between $520.30 and $533.60. It is below the falling 5-day ($529.7) and rising 10-day ($534.1) averages, and above the rising 30-day ($516.8), 100-day ($459.1) and 200-day ($436.3). MACD has been below its signal since Oct 19 but is above zero, histogram widening; Parabolic SAR has been bearish since Oct 16 ($549.08), and RSI is 51.
read.zh: 微软 10月22日下跌 2.2%，收于 $521.08，盘中区间 $520.30–533.60。股价位于下行的 5 日（$529.7）和上行的 10 日均线（$534.1）下方，仍在上行的 30 日（$516.8）、100 日（$459.1）和 200 日均线（$436.3）上方。MACD 自 10月19日起位于信号线下方，但仍在零轴之上，柱状图扩大；抛物线 SAR 自 10月16日起看空（$549.08），RSI 为 51。

read.en: After holding three times, the $524.4–525 support (Oct 16 and 21 lows) gave way on the close and now becomes resistance. Resistance is $524.4–525, then $529.7–534.1 (5 and 10-day) and $544 (Oct 16 high). Support is $516.8 (30-day), then $497–502 (Sep 25–29 lows) and $486 (Sep 10 low). A close below $516.8 would open $497–502; a close above $534 would target $544.

r.en: Oct 16 low $524.4; Oct 21 low $525.0, now resistance
